select t.id, t.user_id as userId, t.company_id as orgId, t.vacation_id as vacationId, ls.start_time as startTime, ls.end_time as endTime, t.leave_reason as leaveReason, t.leave_picture as leavePicture, t.approval_criteria_id as approvalCriteriaId, t.apprpval_status as apprpvalStatus, vs.vacation_status as vacationStatus, ls.schedule_id as scheduleId from leave_info t left join vacation_set vs on t.vacation_id=vs.id left join leave_schedule ls on t.id=ls.leave_id
t.apprpval_status = 1 and vs.vacation_enable=1
and t.user_id in
#{item}
and DATE_FORMAT(t.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(t.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
order by t.start_time asc

select als.* from approval_criteria ac left JOIN approval_level_set als on als.approval_criteria_id = ac.id where ac.start_day < IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,#{startTime},#{endTime})=0,1,TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,#{startTime},#{endTime})) and IFNULL(ac.end_day,9999)>=TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,#{startTime},#{endTime})

SELECT count(*) FROM leave_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND apprpval_status IN (0, 1)

select sum(num) from (SELECT count(*) num FROM field_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND apprpval_status IN (0, 1) union SELECT count(*) num FROM work_overtime_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND apprpval_status IN (0, 1)) a

SELECT ai.leave_id leaveId, ap.user_id userId, als.approval_priority approvalPriority, ai.approval_status approvalStatus, ai.crt_time crtTime FROM approval_info ai LEFT JOIN approval_people ap ON ai.approval_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN approval_level_set als ON ap.approval_level_id = als.id WHERE ai.leave_id = #{id} ORDER BY als.approval_priority

SELECT a.id, a.userId, a.vacationName, a.crtTime, a.startTime, a.endTime, a.leaveTime, a.approvalStatus from (SELECT li.id AS id, li.user_id AS userId, vs.vacation_name AS vacationName, li.crt_time AS crtTime, li.start_time AS startTime, li.end_time AS endTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE ,li.start_time,li.end_time) AS leaveTime, ai.approval_status AS approvalStatus, MAX(als.approval_priority), ap.user_id AS uid FROM leave_info li LEFT JOIN approval_info ai ON ai.leave_id = li.id LEFT JOIN approval_people ap on ai.approval_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN approval_level_set als on ap.approval_level_id = als.id LEFT JOIN vacation_set vs on li.vacation_id = vs.id where ai.approval_status = 0 group BY ai.leave_id) a where a.uid = #{userId}

SELECT li.id AS id, li.user_id AS userId, vs.vacation_name AS vacationName, li.crt_time AS crtTime, li.start_time AS startTime, li.end_time AS endTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE ,li.start_time,li.end_time) AS leaveTime, ai.approval_status AS approvalStatus FROM leave_info li LEFT JOIN approval_info ai ON ai.leave_id = li.id LEFT JOIN approval_people ap on ai.approval_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN approval_level_set als on ap.approval_level_id = als.id LEFT JOIN vacation_set vs on li.vacation_id = vs.id where ai.approval_status in (2,1) and ap.user_id = #{userId} group BY ai.leave_id
